hero.title: Rules you could read out loud
hero.lede: Move the limit and watch which real orders would be handled and which would wait for you. On the test day it was set to $300.

testRun.title: Every step shows what it did
lede: This is a test run from the app. A test uses your real models and store data, and it doesn't send or change anything.

flowList.title: Seven flows ran the test day
flowList.lede: Five came from templates and two were built for this shop. They're checked from the top, and the first one that fits a message runs.

steps.title: Start from a list
steps.text: Each flow says in plain words when it runs. Reorder them and the first match wins.

steps.title: Add the steps
steps.text: Find details in the message, look up the order, check a date, ask the customer. Every check splits into its paths.

image.alt: The flow builder showing the Damaged in transit flow.

steps.title: Set your limit
steps.text: One rule holds the risk: approve by itself when order.total is at most 300.

image.alt: A step setting that approves orders of up to 300 dollars.

steps.text: See every step and its timing before a customer ever reaches it.

items.question: Does the money actually move?
items.answer: Not yet. Crewline records the refund, the order changes and the customer is told. You still press the button in your store or payment provider until those connections exist.

items.question: Can a flow call my other tools?
items.answer: No. Flows work with what's inside Crewline: your imported orders, your documents and your agents.
